description: A single financial priority in the ranked Priorities list. One glass card: leading rank badge, title (+ optional Top pill on rank 1), optional notes, a trailing reorder chevron column, a divider, and an inline Edit/Remove action row. List archetype — reads identically to bills-BillRow and the calendar/dashboard rows.

layout.card: commonStyles.card (glassEffects.glass, radius.lg, padding spacing.lg, marginBottom spacing.md)

topPill.note: Icon + word + color → color-independent. Number in the badge is the primary rank carrier.

accessibility.role: none (card is a group; children are the interactive nodes)
accessibility.removeHint: Double tap to remove this priority
accessibility.note: Rank order conveyed by the number, not medal colors. Top priority = star icon + word TOP, not color alone. Reorder targets ≥ 44pt; disabled arrows expose accessibilityState disabled.

developerNotes: Re-layout of the existing priorities row — no data changes. Drive rank-1 accent + Top pill off `rank === 1` only; every other rank shares the neutral primary2 badge tier (do NOT reintroduce gold/silver/bronze). Remove uses colors.error (replaces bespoke #f472b6) and keeps the destructive confirm Alert. Optimistic reorder animates swapped cards with animation.fast; instant under reduce-motion.
